direction.situation: Outside on a rainy Colombo roadside, just after Kasun handed Anudi her phone and a brief friendly exchange; Anudi has taken a call from her father off-frame left and her mood has shifted.
direction.people: Kasun (on screen, right): a young man in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, wanting to remain kind and open but now attentive and reflective; stands frame right facing left with empty hands below frame. Anudi (off screen left but partially visible by phone and movement): holding the phone in one hand, has moved from warm curiosity to subdued compliance; her changed expression registers on Kasun.

flow.text: Kasun holds his gaze toward Anudi off-frame left. A small, polite smile sits on his lips; his brow gathers slightly as the change in her face registers.
He lets that brief pause play on his face. His eyes drop briefly, as if weighing what he sees, then lift back to meet her eyeline without any intrusive movement.
Kasun presses his lips together lightly, a contained, thoughtful gesture, then releases them; his expression remains gentle and attentive rather than shifting to something dramatic.

As Anudi gets ready to leave (her departing words are heard in the edit but are not spoken here), Kasun's brow relaxes slightly and he stays facing left, hands below frame. He watches her walk away for a moment, his face holding the quiet aftereffect of the interruption.

direction.camera: Close-up (CU) of Kasun at frame right, roadside oblique; locked-off shallow isolation on a 100mm lens.
direction.sound: Light, continuous rain on the road; distant three-wheeler engines and the low hum of city traffic; no music.
